candidate.text: Cilium now respects the port specified as part of the etcd configuration, rather than defaulting it to that of the service when the address matches a Kubernetes service DNS name. Additionally, Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP translation is now automatically enabled for etcd (if necessary); the `etcd.operator` `kvstore-opt` option is now a no-op and has been removed.

evidence.excerpt:
* Cilium now respects the port specified as part of the etcd configuration, rather
  than defaulting it to that of the service when the address matches a Kubernetes
  service DNS name. Additionally, Kubernetes service DNS name to ClusterIP
  translation is now automatically enabled for etcd (if necessary); the
  `etcd.operator` `kvstore-opt` option is now a no-op and has been removed.
